name: @luminary-media-converter/app-electron
description: Desktop shell: hosts the Encoding API in the main process and the web client as its renderer

scripts.pack: ../ffmpeg-build/build.sh && npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify-package
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify-package
scripts.package:win: npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify-package
scripts.package:win-portable: npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --config electron-builder.yml -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && npm run verify-package
